theory_name: Six Birds Theory (SBT) - a finite, audited closure/emergence calculus
one_paragraph_summary: Six Birds Theory (SBT) is a finite, structural, falsification-first calculus of emergence: a 'theory' is a closure package T=(Z,f,Sigma_f,E,A) consisting of a finite micro substrate Z, a coarse-graining lens f:Z->X with induced definability algebra Sigma_f, a packaging/completion endomap E (typically (approximately) idempotent, canonically E_{tau,f}=U_f Q_f P^tau built from a kernel P, lift U_f, pushforward Q_f and timescale tau), and an audit functional A monotone under coarsening. 'Objects' are the fixed points of E; 'emergence' is the existence of stable fixed points; 'open-endedness' is strict theory extension via a generic non-definable predicate; 'directionality' is a positive path-space KL asymmetry Sigma_T or a non-exact log-ratio 1-form (nonzero cycle affinities). The whole edifice is organized by six closure-role primitives P1-P6 (operator rewrite, gating/constraints, protocol holonomy/route mismatch, staging/sectors, packaging, accounting/audit), which Foundations I proves arise canonically (thm:meta-prim) under composability + limited interface access + bounded interfaces; Foundations II/III/IV build admissibility meta-theory, a finite audited interaction calculus, and a 52-law layer-agnostic catalog. SBT recovers only STANDARD mathematical/physical facts (data-processing inequality, detailed-balance zero entropy production, Schnakenberg cycle affinities, Dobrushin uniqueness, lumpability, dephasing idempotence, LES subgrid stress) and explicitly DISCLAIMS empirical realization, deriving continuum theories, deriving the Born rule, and ruling out a cosmological constant. Physics-facing 'retrodictions' are structural normal forms / operational analogues / numerical or Lean-certified diagnostics whose physical content is imported via declarations or delegated to substrate papers, never derived from within the calculus.

core_axioms: A_FIN (finite combinatorial setting): all state/index sets are finite, so KL/sums on finite alphabets are unambiguous and completion/packaging maps are finite-dimensional matrices. [Foundations I, A_FIN, sec 'Assumption bundles']
A_AUT (autonomy): time-homogeneous dynamics; all phase/protocol variables are part of the state (no external schedule). [Foundations I, A_AUT]
A_REV (microreversibility on support): P(z,z')>0 => P(z',z)>0 (bidirected support). [Foundations I, A_REV]

A_ACC (accounting / 1-form decomposition): the antisymmetric log-ratio 1-form a(z,z')=log(P(z,z')/P(z',z)) decomposes into an exact part plus fixed affinity components (graph H^1 viewpoint). [Foundations I, A_ACC]
A_NULL (null regime): all affinity coordinates / cycle integrals vanish (all basis affinities A_r=0). [Foundations I, A_NULL]
A_STAT: a stationary distribution pi exists (full support where required). [Foundations I, A_STAT]
A_LENS: a specified coarse-graining lens f:Z->X is part of every statement. [Foundations I, A_LENS]

Theory = closure package: a theory is a finite package T=(Z,f,Sigma_f,E,A) with Z finite carrier, f a lens inducing definability algebra/partition Sigma_f, E a completion/packaging endomap (typically idempotent), A an audit functional with monotonicity A((g o f)_#(.)) <= A(f_#(.)); objects = Fix(E). [Foundations I, D-TK-THY-01]

Closure-operator axioms: on a poset, a closure operator c is extensive (x<=c(x)), monotone, idempotent (c(c(x))=c(x)); objects = Fix(c). Order-free generalization: an idempotent endomap e (e o e = e) whose fixed points Fix(e) are the packaged objects; order-closures are a special case. [Foundations I, def:closure-operator, sec:idempotent-endo]

Section/packaging-as-closure axiom (physics instantiation): Q_f(U_f nu)=nu for all nu in Delta(X) (section axiom) => E_f=U_f o Q_f idempotent; audit monotonicity (data-processing) A(Q_f mu, Q_f mu') <= A(mu,mu'). [To_Become_a_Stone, section-axiom, audit-monotonicity; Quantum, packaging-closure]

FATCD admissibility (Foundations II): a description D is admissible iff Finite (def:finite), Closed (def:closed: all references/sources/targets/endpoints declared), Audited (def:audited: every claim has an honest-bookkeeping record); role projections P1-P6 are DERIVED, not membership conditions. [Foundations II, def:fatcd]

Recognition hypothesis (Foundations II, ASSUMED not derived): every residual feature of an admissible D is recognized as one of the six role witness types, a six annotation kind, or audit substrate; equivalent to 'no finite audited residual feature irreducible to the six roles'. The scoped exact-six and upper-bound theorems are conditional on it. [Foundations II, def:recognition-hypothesis, rem:recognition-open]

No-smuggling semantics: a primitive is realized without smuggling iff definable using only (i) substrate state carrier, (ii) admitted compositional dynamics, (iii) deterministic lenses and induced constructions, (iv) internal endomaps/audits built from the above; external schedules/equivalences/audits are disallowed ('declaring macrostates by fiat is smuggling'). [To_Lay_a_Stone, def:no-smuggling]

OI-EI principle (methodological): if two scenarios are empirically indiscernible under all admissible experiments at a layer, they must be identified as the same object at that layer (constraint on theory language, not a metaphysical postulate). [Quantum, Principle OI-EI]

primitives.name: Z (micro substrate)
primitives.role: Finite micro state space / space of microdescriptions; canonical dynamics is a row-stochastic Markov kernel P with tau-step kernel P^tau (quantum analogue: density operators + unitary/CPTP T_tau; PDE analogue: time-stepper). [Foundations I; To_Create_a_Stone; Quantum]

primitives.name: f (lens) and Sigma_f (definability algebra)
primitives.role: Deterministic surjective coarse-graining map f:Z->X fixing what is observable; fibers f^{-1}(x) are macro points; induced partition Pi_f and definability sigma-algebra Sigma_f = predicates constant on fibers. A predicate h is definable iff h = h~ o f. [Foundations I, lem:count-definable; To_Create_a_Stone]

primitives.name: P5 - packaging / completion endomap E (and empirical E_{tau,f})
primitives.role: Idempotent(-like) endomap whose fixed points Fix(E) are the packaged objects; canonical empirical instance E_{tau,f}(mu)=U_f(Q_f(mu P^tau)) from kernel P, pushforward Q_f, lift U_f, prototypes u_x, timescale tau. THE core 'objects = fixed points of a completion' role. [Foundations I, sec:idempotent-endo, D-IC-01; To_Lay_a_Stone, def:empirical-packaging]

primitives.name: P6 - accounting / audit (with P6_drive face)
primitives.role: Coarsening-monotone audit functional certifying directionality/drive: path-space KL asymmetry Sigma_T, ACC log-ratio 1-form / cycle affinities, information/feasibility order. P6_drive = the non-exact 1-form / nonzero cycle integral specialization (detailed-balance-breaking affinity). [Foundations I, def P6, rem P6_drive]

primitives.name: P1 - operator rewrite
primitives.role: Rewrite of the substrate operator (replace kernel P by P' / family), changing the endomap; can increase or decrease cycle rank and spectral gap (T-P1-01). Foundations II re-aligns as update-vs-quotient compatibility / descent obstruction (macro-update well-defined iff p~_j q => F(p)~_j F(q), HL-META-1). [Foundations I, def P1; Foundations II, def:primitive-roles]

primitives.name: P2 - gating / constraints
primitives.role: Restricts the support graph by deleting edges and renormalizing (feasibility carving); edge deletion cannot increase beta_1 (T-P2-01). Foundations II re-aligns as macro-specification representability. [Foundations I, def P2, T-P2-01; Foundations II]

primitives.name: P3 - autonomous protocol holonomy / route mismatch
primitives.role: Hidden cyclic/protocol coordinate modeled autonomously on Z=X x Phi; route mismatch RM(j)=d(Pack_{j<-j+2}, Pack_{j<-j+1} o Pack_{j+1<-j+2}). EXPLICITLY NOT a directionality certificate: by itself does not certify arrow-of-time; needs a P6 audit. [Foundations I, def P3, eq:tk-rm]

primitives.name: P4 - staging / sectors / invariants
primitives.role: Conserved sector labels / block structure (Foundations I); in the meta-theorem P4=Staging (refinement chain generates depth index j; bounded interfaces; strict refinement is nontrivial staging, HL-META-2); timescale tau and lens-refinement chains. [Foundations I, def P4, thm:meta-prim; To_Create_a_Stone]

primitives.name: U_f (completion / lift) and prototypes u_x
primitives.role: Canonical lift U_f:Delta(X)->Delta(Z) with Q_f U_f = id; prototype distributions u_x per fiber are SELECTED, not unique (uniform-on-fiber is the canonical default). Recorded as part of the theory package. [Foundations I, D-IC-01; To_Become_a_Stone]

primitives.name: BirdInt^aud_fin (Foundations III central object)
primitives.role: Finite typed audited interaction record tuple (P, Lev, Host, Cont, Instr, Pkg, Prof, Wit, Upd, Def, Judg, Status, Gate, Dep, Audit, Vis, Source, Nonclaim, Real); NOT a category/algebra/closure operator. [Foundations III, sec 4.1]

dynamical_rules: Empirical packaging endomap: E_{tau,f}(mu)=U_f(Q_f(mu P^tau)) (matrix form P^tau Q U); in the ideal/section regime exactly idempotent, fixed points are packaged objects at scale (f,tau). [Foundations I, D-IC-01; To_Lay_a_Stone]

Induced macro kernel: Phat = U_f P^tau Q_f, the closed macro law on X (variants: U P^tau C with prototype lift; sum_{j in B_b}(u_a P^tau)_j). All geometry/thermo/closure audits computed on this object. [To_Create_a_Stone; To_Plot_a_Stone; To_Chart_a_Stone]

One-step stabilization: iterating a fixed closure/packaging operator stabilizes after one step (c^{(n)}(x)=c(x) for n>=1; e^{circ n}=e). Open-endedness CANNOT come from iteration; it requires CHANGING the completion rule. [Foundations I, lem:closure-iterate-stabilizes; No-Go thm:NG_LADDER_IDEM]

Strict theory extension: adjoin a predicate h not definable from f, refining to joint lens (f,h); generic non-definable extension is the open-endedness move. [Foundations I, cor:strict-language-extension]

Arrow-of-time audit: Sigma_T(rho)=D_KL(P_{rho,T} || R_* P_{rho,T}) (forward vs reversed path law); in finite-state stationary case Sigma_T=T*EPR, EPR=sum mu_i P_ij log(mu_i P_ij / mu_j P_ji). Directionality certificate. [Foundations I, D-AOT-01; Protocol_Trap]

Data-processing for the arrow (DPI): for any lens f, D_KL(Q_f-pushforward) <= Sigma_T(rho) (micro >= macro): coarse-graining can hide but not CREATE asymmetry ('no false positives'). [Foundations I, thm:dpi_path / T-AOT-01; No-Go thm:NG_ARROW_DPI]

Protocol trap: reversible clock + each conditional kernel reversible w.r.t. common pi => product stationary + lift reversible => Sigma_T=0 at every finite T. Apparent arrow must come from external schedule (violates A_AUT) or genuine drive/affinity (P6_drive). Decomposition: EPR_lifted = alpha*EPR_clock. [Foundations I, thm:protocol_trap; Protocol_Trap, decomposition lemma]

Closure deficit (macro-closure obstruction): CD_tau(Pi)=I(X_t;Y_{t+tau}|Y_t), with exact decomposition H(Y_{t+tau}|Y_t)=H(Y_{t+tau}|X_t)+CD_tau; CD_tau=0 iff Pi is tau-closed (at tau=1 = classical lumpability); CD_tau = sum_x pi(x) D_KL(p_x^tau || bar-p_{Pi(x)}^tau). The exact obstruction to a closed macro law at lag tau. [To_Cast_a_Stone, prop:cd-decomposition, prop:cd-kl, prop:cd-zero; No-Go thm:NG_MACRO_CLOSURE_DEFICIT]

Dephasing as packaging (quantum): Delta(rho)=sum_i Pi_i rho Pi_i is exactly idempotent with fixed points = diagonal/record-classical states; 'collapse' = idempotent packaging update. [Quantum, thm:dephase]

Self-generated primitives: under composability + limited access + bounded interface, P1-P6 arise canonically as closure mechanics (P5,P6,P4,P2 by construction; P1,P3 the only nontrivial compatibility hypothesis slots). [Foundations I, thm:meta-prim]

certificates.name: Idempotence / TV idempotence defect delta_{tau,f}
certificates.meaning: Stability/objecthood certificate: delta_{tau,f}=sup_mu ||E^2(mu)-E(mu)||_TV; delta<= retention error epsilon; epsilon=0 => exactly idempotent. GUARDRAIL: small defect is a saturation diagnostic ONLY, not a certificate of nontrivial emergence (constant map has delta=0 but one fixed point). [Foundations I, D-IC-02, T-IC-02]

certificates.name: Non-definability / finite forcing
certificates.meaning: Open-endedness/novelty certificate: with N=|Z|, K=|X| exactly 2^K of 2^N predicates are definable; a random predicate is non-definable with prob 1-2^{-(N-K)}; generic extension is strict (thm:finite-forcing). Finite proxy for generic extension, NOT set-theoretic forcing. [Foundations I, lem:count-definable, thm:finite-forcing]

certificates.name: Path-space KL asymmetry Sigma_T (or non-exact 1-form / cycle affinity)
certificates.meaning: Directionality/irreversibility certificate, protected by DPI (no false positives) and the protocol trap (not a hidden-clock artifact). In the AUT+REV+ACC regime: nonzero cycle integral of a(z,z')=log(P/P^T). [Foundations I, D-AOT-01, sec:acc]

certificates.name: Route mismatch RM (P3 diagnostic)
certificates.meaning: Route/protocol-geometry diagnostic RM(x)=||Pack mismatch||; controls gain growth; EXPLICITLY a distinct certificate family, NOT a directionality certificate. [Foundations I, lem:tk-route-capacity; To_Lay_a_Stone]

certificates.name: Closure deficit CD_tau = I(X;Y_{t+tau}|Y_t)
certificates.meaning: Exact macro-closure obstruction certificate; CD_tau>0 iff a macro fiber holds distinct packaged future laws; lower-bounded by route mismatch via Pinsker. CD is NOT irreversibility and NOT novelty. [To_Cast_a_Stone; No-Go]

certificates.name: FATCD decomposition record Dec(D)
certificates.meaning: Per-description scoped exact-six certificate: exactly six role channels, each in exactly one of five statuses {active-projection, below-threshold, collapsed-boundary-case, absent-with-record, outside-scope}. Existential, not unique. [Foundations II, def:channel-status, thm:scoped-exact-six]

certificates.name: Cell/promotion status families (Foundations III)
certificates.meaning: Seven frozen-priority status families (RoleStatus 5, CellStatus 9, PairStatus 4, PromotionStatus 11, ClaimStatus, GateStatus, SqStatus); a finite first-match classifier assigns exactly one status to a covered well-formed record. [Foundations III, sec 5.6, Thm 4]

certificates.meaning: Conjunctive surviving-package certificate: Suf AND Clos AND Stab AND Ctrl AND Hon AND Leg (sufficiency, induced closure, second-stage stability, control admissibility, no-smuggling, slice legibility). [Promotion_Criteria, def:promoted-package-criterion]

certificates.meaning: Carrier-to-event certificate: bridge record B_E admissible iff conjunction of DS,IV,SH,LS,PH,TA,CP,LA,XC,CB; test family admissible iff every member admissible + family predicates. [Carrier_to_Event, def:event-admissibility, def:test-admissibility]

certificates.name: Exposure(Lift,Substrate) predicate
certificates.meaning: Hiddenness CSL certificate: binary predicate deciding dissolution (asymmetry fails) vs preservation (M-vs-Q asymmetry holds); strength-independent. Diagnosis grade only. [Hiddenness, def:visibility-coupling, lem:csl-core]

certificates.name: SPT-legality kappa_j concentration audit
certificates.meaning: Anti-localization certificate: kappa_j(v)=conc_j(v)/f_j; state SPT-legal if kappa_j<=K for every band; forward-closed under invariance (T-SPT-01/02). 'SPT' is an internal anti-localization label, NOT symmetry-protected topological order. [Persistence_of_SPT_Legality, def:spt-legal]

certificates.name: Confluence = elementary flatness = vanishing elementary holonomy
certificates.meaning: Rewriting certificate: local confluence iff every elementary peak joinable iff trivial elementary holonomy on the reduction 2-complex. [To_Flatten_a_Stone, thm:elementary-flatness-iff-local-confluence]

certificates.name: Geometry/thermo audit suite (Phat-derived)
certificates.meaning: Emergent (pseudo)metric d_eta (shortest path on -log Phat), holonomy curvature (Procrustes loop residue), geometrizability R^2_geo, diffusion misfit KL*_diff, EPR/Sigma_T arrow fields. Audit-defined regimes, NOT literal geometry/thermodynamics. [To_Plot_a_Stone; To_Create_a_Stone]

fixed_parameters: Primitive set P = {P1,P2,P3,P4,P5,P6}: fixed six-element role vocabulary, structurally forced under the meta-hypotheses (thm:meta-prim). [Foundations I; Foundations III sec 2.2.1]

Classifier priority orders (per status family): frozen before proofs; uniqueness of covered-cell status depends on the freeze. Cell priority outside_scope > absent > blocked > undefined_circular > collapsed > below_threshold > trivial > implicit > action. [Foundations III, sec 4.3.4, 5.6.2]
Number of definable predicates at a fixed lens: exactly 2^{|im(f)|} (combinatorially fixed). [Foundations I lem:count-definable; Foundations III Thm 14]

Foundations IV trust base: exactly four tagged opacity-guarded axioms (hiddenness_pending, duality_fixity_pending, csl_formed_closure, spontaneous_ssb_formation), each guarded by an opaque source predicate with no public constructor (cannot derive False). [Foundations IV, app:formalization]
Frozen Route A corpus (Promotion): 2 flagship anchors + 4 nearby positives + 4 controls + 1 erasure surface, intentionally narrow. [Promotion_Criteria, sec:methods-core]

Numerical/audit defaults in physics instantiations: DPI tol=1e-8, eps=1e-12, deterministic seed=0 (robustness sweep seeds 0-9); lambda=1 / omega in [0,1] / sigma=0 / s=0 are the null-gate fixed control values. [To_Become_a_Stone; Quantum]
forbidden_moves: Smuggling: declaring macrostates by fiat, importing external schedules / externally declared equivalence relations / externally imposed audits not induced by the substrate. [To_Lay_a_Stone, def:no-smuggling]
Treating P3 route mismatch/holonomy as a directionality (arrow-of-time) certificate without a P6 audit in a model that includes the protocol state. [Foundations I disclaimer; Protocol_Trap]
Reading a small idempotence defect as a certificate of nontrivial emergence/multiplicity (constant map has defect 0). [Foundations I]
Reading closure deficit CD_tau>0 as irreversibility or as forcing a theory extension; it is neither. [To_Cast_a_Stone]
Manufacturing an arrow by external schedule (violates A_AUT) and attributing it to autonomous dynamics. [Foundations I, C-ACC-01]

Claiming a closed macro law when CD_tau>0 / when strong-lumpability defect != 0 (a fitted macro chain is a diagnostic, not theorem evidence for closure). [No-Go thm:NG_MACRO_CLOSURE_DEFICIT; To_Chart_a_Stone]
Attributing force-like / drive structure on a forest or under an exact 1-form (beta_1=0 => no cycle-supported drive). [No-Go thm:NG_FORCE_FOREST, thm:NG_FORCE_NULL]

Expecting open-endedness from iterating a fixed completion, or an infinite ladder of definable predicates at a fixed interface (must change the rule/interface). [No-Go thm:NG_LADDER_IDEM, thm:NG_LADDER_BOUNDED_INTERFACE]
Self-certifying instrument completeness: no finite tower of instruments has a self-certifying top; no complete same-level self-certification. [Foundations III Thm 24,25; Foundations II meta-limit]

Treating a 'law' in Foundations IV as a physical law / universal principle detached from its declared hypotheses; treating model_realization verdicts as theorem-grade. [Foundations IV; Foundations III sec 2.4.4]
Reading instrument-relative acceptance (I |- phi) as instrument-free truth; reading suppressed content as asserted-false. [Foundations III, sec 2.3.3]

missing_interfaces: No rule selecting the lens f / pointer basis / record algebra: which coarse-graining or pointer basis 'nature' picks is an undetermined input (pointer-basis selection explicitly disclaimed; no canonical-lens principle). [Quantum; Foundations I]

No rule producing the completion U_f / prototypes: lifts are SELECTED not unique; no general selection principle beyond examples (uniform-on-fiber, Maxwellian, max-entropy, Gaussian); for LES there is NO canonical U at all (lens-only commutator). [Foundations I; To_Become_a_Stone]

No probability valuation / Born rule: SBT consumes Born-rule predictions; it produces no measure/weights and no amplitudes. Probability is only structurally characterized as a 'stable unresolved fiber' (F23), not derived. [Quantum; Foundations IV F23; To_Cast_a_Stone]

No continuum / continuous-state interface: all constructions finite-state; continuum 'emergence' is only a structural normal form (F43), with no convergence theorem, no metric tensor, no continuum field theory. [To_Plot_a_Stone; Foundations IV F43; To_Become_a_Stone]

No physical-time / spacetime interface: time is a closure artifact (order+measure+arrow) and 'global time' is a protocol-graph potential, explicitly distinct from relativistic foliations; no derivation of physical spacetime. [To_Notch_a_Stone]

No micro-thermodynamic interface: Sigma_T/EPR are informational/audit proxies, NOT physical entropy production; no reservoir/local-detailed-balance interpretation; coarse-graining can hide dissipation. [To_Create_a_Stone; Protocol_Trap]
No single-outcome selection / collapse-ontology interface: SBT does not derive single-outcome selection and takes no stand on ontic vs epistemic collapse. [Quantum]

No Bell / hidden-variable interface: no hidden-variable completion; nonlocal correlations only classified (common-source/interface/nonlocal-residual, F49), not predicted or quantified. [Quantum; Foundations IV F49]

No cosmological measure / vacuum-selection interface: fine-tuning (F47) and vacuum selection (F50) are parametric in an externally declared measure record; the actual cosmological measure and which vacuum is realized are not produced. [Foundations IV; Dark Energy]

No stochastic-lens backbone in the certified core: Lean covers deterministic partition lenses only; stochastic-kernel Q_f generalization (used pervasively in physics examples) is acknowledged future work. [Quantum; To_Become_a_Stone]

No event-package above the protocol-indexed event level on fixed support: the strict-test-to-event ladder terminates in a NON-DEFINABILITY/extension verdict; no accepted test package, shared-event identity, proto-effect, effect algebra, or composition. [Strict_Test_to_Event; Carrier_to_Event]
No universal cross-domain cost unit: budget/currency quantities are comparative within a domain only. [To_Spend_a_Stone]

No general/asymptotic version of several scoped results: no unrestricted exact-six (recognition-completeness open), no general TRS confluence-as-flatness theorem, no asymptotic P!=NP, no universal SPT capacity-contraction, no general invariance HL-SPT-INV for arbitrary dynamics. SPT-legality / membrane machinery imports frame/Riesz-sequence theory, operator theory (Schur complements, Douglas factorization, Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse, Loewner order) and concentration-compactness (Lions/Evans) language; the model is a generic finite-dimensional Hilbert space with no specific physical Hamiltonian.

Information theory (Shannon entropy, conditional MI, KL, Pinsker, DPI), MaxEnt/MaxCal Gibbs form q ~ exp(-lambda u) (puts the Boltzmann form in by hand), lumpability theory, and rewriting theory (Knuth-Bendix, Squier, Guiraud-Malbos, Newman) are imported standard mathematics; the genuinely novel self-contained results (CD decomposition identity; flatness=local-confluence) are elementary once set up.

Several 'emergent' geometries are SEEDED by physically-coordinated substrate generators (S^2 sphere, 2D torus) and by spectral/diffusion-map lens construction (acknowledged circularity risk): the curvature/Euclidean structure partly inherits the inductive bias of the chosen embedding geometry and of spectral embedding.
